rows.grounds: fused form tena + añjanena; instrumental sense

items.question: How does the world attain subjection through that anointing?
items.inference: That anointing brings the world into subjection.
uncertainties: Exact referent of that anointing is unspecified.
items.plain_english: By that anointing, the world indeed goes into subjection.
